content: ffmpeg-kit retired 6 Jan 2025 (Taner Sener/Arthenica); GitHub repo archived read-only; binaries removed from Maven Central/CocoaPods/npm on schedule (<6.0 until 1 Feb 2025, >=6.0 until 1 Apr 2025). com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-full-gpl:6.0-2 no longer resolves. Community fork ffmpegkit-maintained (dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:ffmpeg-kit-full-gpl, package kept as com.arthenica.ffmpegkit) enforces 16 KB alignment, ships 6.0/7.1/8.1 LTS lines on NDK r26c/r27c, arm64-v8a only, LGPL or GPL-3.0 variants.
